name: slack
description: Search, read, summarize, and send Slack workspace content through Slack's official hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Slack through its official MCP
interface.longDescription: Connect Cusco to Slack's official hosted MCP server with a user-owned registered Slack app and PKCE. Search workspace messages, channels, files, emoji, and people; read conversations; and perform reviewed messaging, reaction, conversation, and canvas actions within the authorized user's permissions.
defaultPrompt: Search Slack for a topic and summarize the relevant threads
Draft a Slack reply from this context
Review a Slack channel and identify decisions and follow-ups
